import pytest
from tally.counter import totals
from tally.report import summary


class TestTotalsMissingHold:
    """Tests that totals ignores items whose hold is missing or empty."""

    def test_ignores_missing_hold_key(self):
        """Items without a 'hold' key should be ignored."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "A"},
            {"hold": "B"},
            {"weight": 10},  # missing hold key
        ]
        result = totals(items)
        assert result == {"A": 1, "B": 1}
        assert "hold" not in result
        assert None not in result

    def test_ignores_empty_string_hold(self):
        """Items with an empty string hold should be ignored."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "A"},
            {"hold": ""},
            {"hold": "B"},
        ]
        result = totals(items)
        assert result == {"A": 1, "B": 1}
        assert "" not in result

    def test_ignores_none_hold(self):
        """Items with None hold should be ignored."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "A"},
            {"hold": None},
            {"hold": "B"},
        ]
        result = totals(items)
        assert result == {"A": 1, "B": 1}
        assert None not in result

    def test_ignores_whitespace_only_hold(self):
        """Items with whitespace-only hold should be ignored."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "A"},
            {"hold": "   "},
            {"hold": "\t\n"},
            {"hold": "B"},
        ]
        result = totals(items)
        assert result == {"A": 1, "B": 1}
        assert "   " not in result
        assert "\t\n" not in result

    def test_all_items_missing_hold(self):
        """If all items are missing hold, result should be empty dict."""
        items = [
            {"weight": 10},
            {"id": 1},
        ]
        result = totals(items)
        assert result == {}

    def test_all_items_empty_hold(self):
        """If all items have empty hold, result should be empty dict."""
        items = [
            {"hold": ""},
            {"hold": None},
        ]
        result = totals(items)
        assert result == {}

    def test_mixed_valid_and_invalid_holds(self):
        """Only valid holds should be counted."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "C"},
            {"hold": ""},
            {"hold": "A"},
            {"hold": None},
            {"hold": "B"},
        ]
        result = totals(items)
        assert result == {"C": 1, "A": 1, "B": 1}
        assert len(result) == 3


class TestSummaryAlphabeticalOrder:
    """Tests that summary lists holds in alphabetical order."""

    def test_summary_alphabetical_order(self):
        """Holds should be listed in alphabetical order."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "C"},
            {"hold": "A"},
            {"hold": "B"},
            {"hold": "A"},
            {"hold": "C"},
            {"hold": "C"},
        ]
        result = summary(items)
        # Expected: A=2, B=1, C=3 in alphabetical order
        assert result == "A=2, B=1, C=3"

    def test_summary_single_hold(self):
        """Single hold should appear as is."""
        items = [{"hold": "Z"}]
        result = summary(items)
        assert result == "Z=1"

    def test_summary_no_holds(self):
        """No valid holds should produce empty string."""
        items = [
            {"hold": ""},
            {"hold": None},
        ]
        result = summary(items)
        assert result == ""

    def test_summary_multiple_same_hold(self):
        """Multiple items in same hold should be counted correctly."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "B"},
            {"hold": "B"},
            {"hold": "B"},
        ]
        result = summary(items)
        assert result == "B=3"

    def test_summary_three_holds_alphabetical(self):
        """Three different holds should be in alphabetical order."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "Mango"},
            {"hold": "Apple"},
            {"hold": "Banana"},
        ]
        result = summary(items)
        assert result == "Apple=1, Banana=1, Mango=1"

    def test_summary_preserves_counts_with_ordering(self):
        """Counts should be correct and order should be alphabetical."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "Zulu"},
            {"hold": "Alpha"},
            {"hold": "Alpha"},
            {"hold": "Bravo"},
            {"hold": "Bravo"},
            {"hold": "Bravo"},
            {"hold": "Charlie"},
        ]
        result = summary(items)
        assert result == "Alpha=2, Bravo=3, Charlie=1, Zulu=1"

    def test_summary_with_invalid_holds_filtered(self):
        """Invalid holds should be filtered out, remaining holds in alphabetical order."""
        items = [
            {"hold": "Z"},
            {"hold": ""},
            {"hold": "A"},
            {"hold": None},
            {"hold": "M"},
        ]
        result = summary(items)
        assert result == "A=1, M=1, Z=1"
